__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. It was written by reading docs/opnsense-api-survey.md, section Push sources (S5 and S9, which cite opnsense/core 26.7.3's NetflowController.php and the OPNsense.Netflow model), never by recording what a firewall answered. If the survey is wrong about the shape, the tests that read this file pass and the reading is still wrong. Do not treat this file as evidence; replace it with a recorded answer rewritten under X1 once LV-NJ has run.
